done.title: Implement hello-api Go service with greeting endpoint
done.description:
> Provide a single Go service that responds with Hello, World! or Hello, [name]! per the spec.

## Overview

Build `hello-api`, a new Go service (`net/http`, port 9090) that is the sole component of this project. It exposes a simple greeting endpoint used to verify the platform is working end-to-end, and optionally personalizes the greeting when a name is supplied.

## Scope

- Implement `GET /health` returning 200 "OK", no auth.
- Implement `GET /hello` returning JSON `{"message": "Hello, World!"}`; when a `name` query parameter is present, return `{"message": "Hello, <name>!"}` instead.
- This is a public, unauthenticated API: do NOT implement any `/auth/*` endpoints, JWT validation, or CORS middleware — the gateway (if applied) handles CORS, and no `exposesAPI.auth` is set on this component.
- Stateless service: do NOT add a database, storage component, or scheduled/cron tasks.
- Dockerfile builder base image: use `FROM golang:1.25-alpine AS builder`. The build pod runs with `GOTOOLCHAIN=local` and will NOT auto-download a newer Go toolchain — an older base image causes `go mod download` to fail with `go.mod requires go >= X.Y` at build time even when local `go build` succeeds.
- Do not modify other components in this repo (there are none currently, but keep this task scoped to `hello-api` only).

## Acceptance criteria

- `GET /health` returns 200 "OK" with no authentication required.
- `GET /hello` returns 200 with JSON `{"message": "Hello, World!"}` when no `name` param is given.
- `GET /hello?name=Alice` returns 200 with JSON `{"message": "Hello, Alice!"}`.
- Any error response (e.g. malformed query input) uses `application/problem+json` with `type`, `title`, `status` fields.
- No CORS middleware and no JWT/auth code is present anywhere in the service.
- Local `go build -o /dev/null ./...` exits 0. Since this service needs no external dependencies, no `go.sum` should be present — do not hand-create one.

## References

- `specs/design/components/hello-api/design.md` and `specs/design/components/hello-api/openapi.yaml` (via the platform's Component Reference card) define the exact contract — implement it as specified there.
- `specs/requirements/requirements.md` — Features section describes the greeting behavior this endpoint must satisfy.

## Task dependencies

None.
